title: The Mysterious World of Secret Societies
speaker: Alastair Budge

sentences.en: Hello, hello hello, and welcome to English Learning for Curious Minds, by Leonardo English.
sentences.zh: 您好，您好，欢迎收听由 Leonardo Foundation 制作的英语学习播客《English Learning for Curious Minds》。

sentences.en: The show where you can listen to fascinating stories, and learn weird and wonderful things about the world at the same time as improving your English.
sentences.zh: 在这个节目中，你可以聆听迷人的故事，了解世界上光怪陆离的奇妙事物，同时还能提高你的英语水平。

sentences.en: I'm Alastair Budge, and today is the start of another three-part mini-series.
sentences.zh: 我是阿拉斯泰尔·巴多克（Alastair Budge），今天是另一个三集迷你系列的开篇。

sentences.en: And for our first mini-series of the year, the first of 2025, the loose theme will be “mystery”.
sentences.zh: 作为我们今年的第一个迷你系列，也就是2025年的第一个系列，本系列的主题是“神秘”。

sentences.en: In part one, this episode, we are going to be talking about the shady world of secret societies, and take a close look at three mysterious societies some people believe hold great power.
sentences.zh: 在第一部分，也就是本期节目中，我们将探讨秘密社团的神秘世界，并仔细研究三个被一些人认为掌握着巨大权力的神秘组织。

sentences.en: Next up, in part two, we will talk about the art of espionage, and look at the curious history of spying.
sentences.zh: 接下来，在第二部分中，我们将探讨间谍艺术，并回顾一下间谍活动奇特的历史。

sentences.en: And in part three we will finish it off with some stories of amazing lost civilisations, civilisations that some people believe once existed but of which all traces have now vanished.
sentences.zh: 而在第三部分，我们将以一些关于失落文明的惊人故事来收尾，这些文明有些人认为曾经存在过，但其所有痕迹如今都已消失不见。

sentences.en: OK then, let’s get right into it and talk about the shady world of secret societies.
sentences.zh: 好了，那我们马上切入正题，来聊聊秘密社团的神秘世界吧。

sentences.en: An interesting piece of trivia for you is that the record for the longest continuous film shoot is held by Stanley Kubrick, for his 1999 mystery thriller, Eyes Wide Shut.
sentences.zh: 一个有趣的冷知识是，最长连续电影拍摄纪录的保持者是斯坦利·库布里克（Stanley Kubrick），作品是他1999年的悬疑惊悚片《大开眼戒》（Eyes Wide Shut）。

sentences.en: It was a gargantuan effort, a huge piece of work, and Kubrick died of a heart attack just six days after showing the final version to Warner Brothers, the studio behind the film.
sentences.zh: 这是一项极其浩大的工程、一部巨作，库布里克在将最终版本放映给该片的制片厂华纳兄弟（Warner Brothers）仅六天后，便因心脏病发作去世了。

sentences.en: If you’ve seen this film, you’ll remember that it stars Tom Cruise and Nicole Kidman.
sentences.zh: 如果你看过这部电影，你就会记得它由汤姆·克鲁斯（Tom Cruise）和妮可·基德曼（Nicole Kidman）主演。

sentences.en: There is a scene in the movie where the character played by Tom Cruise is told about a mysterious party at a mansion outside New York City, held by a secret and highly exclusive society.
sentences.zh: 电影中有一个场景，汤姆·克鲁斯饰演的角色听说在纽约市郊的一座豪宅里有一个神秘派对，由一个秘密且极具排他性的社团举办。

sentences.en: A special password is required to be allowed in, and everyone is required to wear a mask, to disguise their true identity.
sentences.zh: 进入需要特殊的密码，而且每个人都必须戴上面具，以掩盖他们的真实身份。

sentences.en: Now, many of the characters aren’t wearing much else, and the film continues with several scenes too explicit to be described on a family-friendly podcast and without an advanced knowledge of vocabulary relating to human anatomy.
sentences.zh: 现在，许多角色的穿着也仅限于此，电影接下来的几个场景过于露骨，不适合在一个适合全家收听且缺乏人体解剖学高级词汇的播客中进行描述。

sentences.en: But this underlines our obsession with the idea of secret societies.
sentences.zh: 但这突显了我们对秘密社团这种概念的痴迷。

sentences.en: Behind closed doors, anything could be happening.
sentences.zh: 在紧闭的大门背后，任何事情都有可能发生。

sentences.en: Men and women in strange masks, unusual passwords or codes, promises of brotherhood, and, of course, sworn oaths of secrecy, which only serve to add to the allure.
sentences.zh: 戴着奇怪面具的男女、不寻常的密码或暗号、兄弟会的承诺，当然还有宣誓保密，这些都只会增添其诱惑力。

sentences.en: Naturally, the very nature of a secret society is that, if it really is a secret society, the goings-on of the society, its rituals and the identities of its members are a closely guarded secret.
sentences.zh: 自然而然，秘密社团的本质就在于，如果它真的是一个秘密社团，那么该社团的活动、仪式以及成员的身份都是严守的秘密。

sentences.en: Members of the public might have some idea about its existence, some photos might exist of members together, but beyond that, little is known about what actually happens.
sentences.zh: 公众可能会对其存在有所耳闻，也可能会有一些成员在一起的照片，但除此之外，对于实际发生的事情却知之甚少。

sentences.en: And such is, or perhaps I should say “such was”, the case with Skull and Bones, a secret society at Yale University, one of the top-ranked and most prestigious Ivy League universities.
sentences.zh: 骷髅会（Skull and Bones）就是这种情况，或者我应该说“曾经是”这种情况，它是耶鲁大学的一个秘密社会，耶鲁大学是排名最高且最具声望的常春藤盟校之一。

sentences.en: Skull and Bones was founded in 1832, during a time of great change in the United States.
sentences.zh: 骷髅会成立于1832年，正值美国发生巨大变革的时期。

sentences.en: The country was still young, having declared independence only 56 years earlier, and the idea of shaping a national identity was at the forefront.
sentences.zh: 当时这个国家还很年轻，仅在56年前才宣布独立，塑造国家认同的理念正处于最前沿。

sentences.en: Elite universities like Yale were hubs for the children of wealthy and influential families, and they served as training grounds for the next generation of leaders.
sentences.zh: 像耶鲁这样的精英大学是富裕和有影响力家庭子女的聚集地，它们充当着培养下一代领袖的训练营。

sentences.en: Secret societies were becoming a trend in academic institutions, providing students with a sense of exclusivity and camaraderie.
sentences.zh: 秘密社团在学术机构中正成为一种潮流，为学生提供了一种排他感和同伴情谊。

sentences.en: Skull and Bones was established as one of these societies, but it quickly distinguished itself by its intense secrecy and the powerful network it offered its members, of which there were only 15 new ones every year.
sentences.zh: 骷髅会作为这些社团之一成立，但它很快凭借其高度的保密性以及为成员提供的强大网络而脱颖而出，这里每年只有15名新成员。

sentences.en: By focusing on rituals and an elite membership, it cemented its reputation as a group that was as mysterious as it was influential.
sentences.zh: 通过专注于仪式和精英成员，它巩固了自己作为一个既神秘又具影响力的团体的声誉。

sentences.en: And right from the very early days, it was the subject of intrigue and mystery for students at the university, students who were not members, of course.
sentences.zh: 而且从很早的时候起，它就是大学里学生们津津乐道和充满神秘感的话题，当然，这些学生都不是会员。

sentences.en: To quote one book about Yale from 1871, “the mystery now attending its existence forms the one great enigma which college gossip never tires of discussing."
sentences.zh: 引用1871年关于耶鲁大学的一本书的话，“现在围绕其存在的神秘感构成了大学八卦永远讨论不腻的谜团。”

sentences.en: In other words, nobody knows anything about it, so everyone talks about it.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，没有人知道关于它的任何事情，所以每个人都在谈论它。

sentences.en: Now, with time, information has come out about people who were members of Skull & Bones, and it reads like a who’s-who of America’s elite.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，关于骷髅会成员的信息逐渐浮出水面，读起来就像是一份美国精英的名人录。

sentences.en: Rockefellers and Vanderbilts were admitted, as well as three generations of the Bush family.
sentences.zh: 洛克菲勒家族和范德比尔特家族都被接纳了，布什家族的三代人也是如此。

sentences.en: Prescott Bush, in the class of 1917, his son George H.W.
sentences.zh: 普雷斯科特·布什（Prescott Bush），1917届毕业生，他的儿子乔治·H·W·

sentences.en: Bush, in the class of 1948, and his son, George W.
sentences.zh: 布什，1948届毕业生，还有他的儿子乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush, who was in the class of 1968. In fact, the 2004 US Presidential Election was contested by two former members of Skull and Bones: George W.
sentences.zh: 布什，1968届毕业生。事实上，2004年的美国总统大选是由两位骷髅会的前成员竞选的：乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush was one of them, and John Kerry was the other.
sentences.zh: 布什是其中之一，约翰·克里（John Kerry）是另一个。

sentences.en: And outside of politics, a list of former members contains powerful and well-known lawyers, journalists, financiers, high-powered CEOs, men–and for a long time it was exclusively men–who controlled hundreds of billions of dollars, newspapers, political parties or even ran countries.
sentences.zh: 而在政治之外，前成员名单中包含了权势滔天且广为人知的律师、记者、金融家、高级首席执行官，这些男性——在很长一段时间里它完全由男性组成——控制着数千亿美元、报纸、政党甚至统治着国家。

sentences.en: This has, as you might imagine, led to a lot of speculation about the nature of membership, of what being part of Skull and Bones entails, and why such a high proportion of its members go on to positions of importance.
sentences.zh: 正如你所想象的那样，这导致了许多关于会员性质的猜测，即成为骷髅会一部分意味着什么，以及为什么其如此高比例的成员会走向重要职位。

sentences.en: Are former members of this society all helping each other, ensuring that the ties formed as twenty-something-year-old students remain in place for life?
sentences.zh: 这个社团的前成员是否都在互相帮助，确保二十多岁当学生时建立的纽带能够维持一生？

sentences.en: Or, instead, is it that Skull and Bones selects the most promising students at an already highly exclusive university, so these are people who would have gone on to fame, wealth and power even if they had never been admitted to Skull and Bones?
sentences.zh: 或者相反，是因为骷髅会在本就极具排他性的大学里挑选了最有前途的学生，所以这些人即使从未被骷髅会录取，也依然会走向名誉、财富和权力？

sentences.en: Of course, it is a secret society, and members are required to swear an oath of secrecy; it is impossible to know for sure what membership of Skull & Bones entails and what is expected of former members after they graduate.
sentences.zh: 当然，它是一个秘密社团，成员被要求发誓保密；要确切知道加入骷髅会意味着什么，以及对前成员毕业后有何期望，这是不可能的。

sentences.en: But we have some clues about what goes on behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 但我们对闭门幕后发生的事情有一些线索。

sentences.en: In April of 2001, the New York Observer reported that it had managed to gain access to the initiation ceremony, the event in which 15 new members were welcomed into the society.
sentences.zh: 2001年4月，《纽约观察家报》（New York Observer）报道称，它设法进入了入会仪式，即15名新成员被欢迎加入该社团的活动。

sentences.en: What the newspaper revealed was… plain weird.
sentences.zh: 这家报纸揭露的内容是……简直匪夷所思。

sentences.en: The ceremony involved young men screaming sexual insults at each other, others forced to kneel down and kiss a skull, and pretend to cut the throat of another member.
sentences.zh: 仪式包括年轻男子互相尖叫黄色笑话，其他人被迫跪下亲吻头骨，并假装割断另一名成员的喉咙。

sentences.en: Death was a recurrent theme, as you might imagine for a society named “Skull & Bones”, and there was almost as much nudity as in Stanley Kubrick’s Eyes Wide Shut.
sentences.zh: 死亡是一个反复出现的主题，正如你对一个名为“骷髅会”的社团所想象的那样，那里几乎和斯坦利·库布里克的《大开眼戒》一样有大量的裸露镜头。

sentences.en: It was all very unusual, but was an age-old tradition that brought these university students closer together in a bond that united them for life.
sentences.zh: 这一切都非常不寻常，但却是一个历史悠久的传统，它将这些大学生以一种终身联合的纽带拉得更近。

sentences.en: Now, Skull and Bones might be one of the most famous in America, but it is neither the oldest nor the best known, outside of the US at least.
sentences.zh: 现在，骷髅会可能是美国最著名的社团之一，但它既不是最古老的，也不是在美国以外最知名的。

sentences.en: One of the oldest and most famous secret societies is the Knights Templar, or the Templars, a Catholic military order founded in Jerusalem in 1119.
sentences.zh: 最古老、最著名的秘密社团之一是圣殿骑士团（Knights Templar），或简称圣殿骑士，这是一个于1119年在耶路撒冷成立的天主教军事修会。

sentences.en: It was first created for religious reasons, to protect Christian pilgrims travelling to the Holy Land.
sentences.zh: 它最初是为了宗教原因而创建的，旨在保护前往圣地的基督教朝圣者。

sentences.en: This was in the aftermath of the First Crusade.
sentences.zh: 这是在第一次十字军东征之后。

sentences.en: Christian armies had managed to capture Jerusalem in 1099, and thousands of European pilgrims were inspired to make the journey to the Holy Land.
sentences.zh: 基督教军队于1099年成功攻占了耶路撒冷，成千上万的欧洲朝圣者受到启发，踏上了前往圣地的旅程。

sentences.en: To state the obvious, this was a difficult and dangerous journey.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，这是一段艰难而危险的旅程。

sentences.en: It was long, and the route was filled with bandits and hostile forces.
sentences.zh: 路途遥远，沿途布满了强盗和敌对势力。

sentences.en: This is where the Knights Templar stepped in.
sentences.zh: 圣殿骑士团正是在这个时候介入的。

sentences.en: Their job, their entire reason for existence, was to offer protection so that pilgrims could complete their spiritual journey safely.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作，他们存在的全部理由，就是提供保护，以便朝圣者能够安全地完成他们的精神之旅。

sentences.en: Initially, it was a poor, religious order, with no real financial resources and just a handful of knights.
sentences.zh: 最初，这是一个贫穷的宗教修会，没有真正的财政资源，只有区区几个骑士。

sentences.en: These knights were required to take an oath of poverty, pledging to hand over all of their material possessions to the order.
sentences.zh: 这些骑士被要求发誓过贫困生活，承诺将他们所有的物质财产上交给修会。

sentences.en: But, before too long, the order gained the support of the Catholic Church, and it was given special privileges.
sentences.zh: 但是，没过多久，该修会便获得了天主教会的支持，并被赋予了特权。

sentences.en: These included the ability to collect taxes, build fortifications, and operate independently of local authorities.
sentences.zh: 其中包括征税、建造防御工事以及独立于地方当局运作的能力。

sentences.en: It got endorsements from the pope, and wealthy Christian nobles handed over their fortunes to the order, to help it continue its holy mission of enabling Europeans to make this dangerous pilgrimage safely.
sentences.zh: 它得到了教皇的背书，富有的基督教贵族将他们的财富交给了该修会，以帮助其继续完成使欧洲人能够安全进行这次危险朝圣的神圣使命。

sentences.en: So, the knights of the Knights Templar played an unusual role.
sentences.zh: 因此，圣殿骑士团的骑士们扮演了一个不同寻常的角色。

sentences.en: On the one hand, they lived austere lives, vowing poverty and chastity, praying, and following strict religious rules.
sentences.zh: 一方面，他们过着简朴的生活，发誓贫穷和贞洁，祈祷并遵循严格的宗教戒律。

sentences.en: On the other hand, they were highly trained and disciplined soldiers who were feared on the battlefield.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，他们是训练有素、纪律严明的士兵，在战场上令人闻风丧胆。

sentences.en: And, today we would also probably call them business pioneers.
sentences.zh: 而且，今天我们大概也会称他们为商业先驱。

sentences.en: What they ended up developing was an early form of banking and international money transfer.
sentences.zh: 他们最终发展出的是早期的银行业和国际汇款业务。

sentences.en: Let’s say a Christian pilgrim in France was planning to go to Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 比方说，法国的一个基督教朝圣者正计划前往耶路撒冷。

sentences.en: It was a long, dangerous and expensive trip, and carrying all of your gold and valuables in a purse, on your person, was a recipe for disaster.
sentences.zh: 这是一段漫长、危险且昂贵的旅程，把所有的黄金和贵重物品装在钱袋里带在身上，简直是自寻死路。

sentences.en: So, instead, this person might go to a Templar in Europe and leave their gold or valuables, and be provided with a note that goods of equal value could be exchanged for this note at certain places along the route, or when the pilgrim eventually arrived in Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个人可以去找欧洲的圣殿骑士，把黄金或贵重物品交给他，并拿到一张凭条；凭借这张凭条，沿途特定地点的货物或等值现金就可以兑换出来，当朝圣者最终到达耶路撒冷时也可以兑换。

sentences.en: Then, they would have a series of notes that could be redeemed for goods or services along the way, just like…modern money.
sentences.zh: 接着，他们就会有一系列可以在沿途兑换商品或服务的凭条，就像……现代货币一样。

sentences.en: As the order expanded, its role changed from simply protecting pilgrims on the journey with their weapons to one of administration, finance and governance.
sentences.zh: 随着该组织的扩张，其角色从单纯用武器保护朝圣者，转变为负责行政、金融和治理。

sentences.en: And, as you might imagine, with this came serious power, but it would come to be their downfall.
sentences.zh: 正如你所想象的那样，随之而来的是巨大的权力，但这也将成为他们覆灭的原因。

sentences.en: Now, the going was good for the Knights Templar for 100 years or so, but when the Christian Crusaders were finally defeated in 1291 at the Siege of Acre and effectively booted out of the Middle East, the tide turned for the Knights.
sentences.zh: 圣殿骑士的好日子大约持续了100年，但当基督教十字军在1291年的阿卡围城战中最终被击败、实际上被逐出中东时，骑士团的时运就逆转了。

sentences.en: Their raison d’être, their entire reason for existence, was gone.
sentences.zh: 他们存在的理由，即他们存在的全部意义，消失了。

sentences.en: They were forced to flee, first to Cyprus, before having to escape from the island and return to mainland Europe.
sentences.zh: 他们被迫逃亡，先是逃到塞浦路斯，然后又不得不逃离该岛，返回欧洲大陆。

sentences.en: But the order didn’t just disband; it had tens of thousands of members, business interests throughout Europe and the Middle East, and although it was not as influential as it had once been, it was still a powerful force.
sentences.zh: 但该组织并没有就此解散；它拥有数万名成员，在欧洲和中东都有商业利益，尽管它已不如昔日那般具有影响力，但它仍然是一股强大的力量。

sentences.en: In 1306, the leader of the Knights Templar was summoned to France to meet with Pope Clement V.
sentences.zh: 1306年，圣殿骑士团的领袖被召至法国，与克莱门特五世教皇会面。

sentences.en: The meeting was ostensibly to discuss merging The Knights Templar with the Knights Hospitaller, a slightly older organisation whose objective was to care for injured pilgrims.
sentences.zh: 这次会面表面上是为了讨论将圣殿骑士团与医院骑士团合并，后者是一个稍早成立的组织，其宗旨是照顾受伤的朝圣者。

sentences.en: Neither leader was keen on the idea of combining forces, but unbeknownst to them, there was another plan being hatched.
sentences.zh: 两位领袖都不太热衷于合并的想法，但他们不知道的是，另一个计划正在酝酿之中。

sentences.en: Someone wanted to destroy the Knights Templar altogether.
sentences.zh: 有人想要彻底摧毁圣殿骑士团。

sentences.en: The French king, Philip IV, was deeply in debt to the Knights, after an expensive war against the English.
sentences.zh: 法国国王腓力四世由于对英格兰进行了一场昂贵的战争，欠了骑士团巨额债务。

sentences.en: Seizing the Knights Templars’ wealth was a convenient way to refill his coffers under the guise of justice.
sentences.zh: 掠夺圣殿骑士团的财富成了他以正义为幌子来充盈国库的便捷方法。

sentences.en: He seized on the idea of charging the Knights with some kind of crime that would allow him to dismantle the organisation, seize its wealth and free himself of his debts.
sentences.zh: 他抓住了一个想法，那就是指控骑士团犯下某种罪行，从而让他能够解散该组织、掠夺其财富并摆脱债务。

sentences.en: Given his influence, he managed to persuade the Pope to do this on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他的影响力，他成功说服教皇代为行事。

sentences.en: Dozens of knights were rounded up, interrogated and tortured.
sentences.zh: 数十名骑士被搜捕、审讯并遭受酷刑。

sentences.en: Their crimes, or accused crimes, I should say?
sentences.zh: 他们的罪名，或者说被指控的罪名，我应该这么说？

sentences.en: These were as wide-ranging as spitting on the cross, worshipping idols, homosexual practices, and financial impropriety.
sentences.zh: 这些指控五花八门，从向十字架吐口水、崇拜偶像、同性恋行为，到财务违规。

sentences.en: Many of the knights admitted to these crimes under extreme torture and found themselves burned at the stake, executed publicly.
sentences.zh: 许多骑士在极端酷刑下承认了这些罪行，结果发现自己被绑在火刑柱上公开处决。

sentences.en: One who refused to confess was the temple grandmaster, the leader of the order, Jacques de Molay.
sentences.zh: 有一个拒绝招供的人是圣殿骑士团大团长雅克·德·莫莱。

sentences.en: According to one eye-witness, as he was being burned alive, with his last words, he asked God to take revenge on the men who had tormented him.
sentences.zh: 根据一位目击者的说法，当他被活活烧死时，他用最后的遗言祈求上帝向折磨他的人复仇。

sentences.en: Perhaps a perfectly reasonable sentiment if you have been unjustly accused of all sorts of crimes and you find yourself being publicly burned to death.
sentences.zh: 如果你被无端指控了各种罪名，又发现自己正被当众烧死，这或许是一种完全合乎情理的情绪。

sentences.en: Anyway, his dying wish seems to have been granted.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，他临终的愿望似乎实现了。

sentences.en: He was executed in March of 1314, and less than a year later, both the French king and his puppet pope, Clement V, were also dead.
sentences.zh: 他在1314年3月被处决，不到一年后，法国国王和他的傀儡教皇克莱门特五世也双双身亡。

sentences.en: Now, the Knights Templar was officially disbanded in 1309, its leaders burned at the stake, but there are some people who believe that the order simply retreated into the shadows.
sentences.zh: 圣殿骑士团于1309年被正式解散，其领袖被绑在火刑柱上烧死，但有些人相信该组织只是退入了阴影之中。

sentences.en: We know that many former Knights ended up joining similar societies, such as The Order of Christ, which is still around today and is headquartered in Portugal.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，许多前圣殿骑士最终加入了类似的社团，比如今天依然存在、总部位于葡萄牙的基督骑士团。

sentences.en: But what of the main order, the Knights Templar?
sentences.zh: 但主要的组织——圣殿骑士团怎么样了呢？

sentences.en: Well, the problem with a secret society is that, even if there is no firm evidence for it existing, this doesn’t stop people from believing it still exists.
sentences.zh: 好吧，秘密社团的问题在于，即便没有确凿证据证明其存在，也无法阻止人们相信它依然存在。

sentences.en: After all, a secret society that everyone knows about isn’t a very good secret society.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，人人都知道的秘密社团可算不上什么好秘密社团。

sentences.en: And this intrigue over whether it still exists has led to some pretty awful crimes being committed in the name of the Knights Templar.
sentences.zh: 这种对它是否依然存在的猜测，导致了一些以圣殿骑士团之名犯下的恶劣罪行。

sentences.en: For example, it was named by the Norwegian terrorist Anders Breivik, who murdered 77 people in 2011.
sentences.zh: 例如，在2011年谋杀77人的挪威恐怖分子Anders Breivik就提到了它。

sentences.en: He claimed to be part of a reborn cell of the Knights Templar, a group fighting against multiculturalism in Europe and continuing what they saw to be the work of the Knights Templar protecting Christians against Muslims.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己是复兴的圣殿骑士团分支的一员，该组织反对欧洲的多元文化主义，并继续他们眼中圣殿骑士团保护基督徒免受穆斯林侵害的事业。

sentences.en: Pretty vile stuff, indeed. Now, let’s turn our attention to our last secret society, another enigmatic society that has captured the imagination of many: the Freemasons.
sentences.zh: 确实是非常卑鄙的行径。现在，让我们把注意力转向最后一个秘密社团，另一个激发了无数人想象力的神秘组织：共济会。

sentences.en: Unlike Skull and Bones or the Knights Templar, Freemasonry isn’t confined to a single institution or hidden in history.
sentences.zh: 与骷髅会或圣殿骑士团不同，共济会并不局限于某一单一机构，也没有隐匿于历史之中。

sentences.en: It’s more like a global brotherhood that spans centuries and continents, with members that include historical figures like George Washington, Winston Churchill, and Mozart.
sentences.zh: 它更像是一个跨越数个世纪和各大洲的全球兄弟会，其成员包括乔治·华盛顿、温斯顿·丘吉尔和莫扎特等历史人物。

sentences.en: Freemasonry traces its origins back to the 14th century, to medieval stonemasons’ guilds, organisations of skilled masons who built Europe’s great cathedrals.
sentences.zh: 共济会的起源可以追溯到14世纪的中世纪石匠行会，那是建造欧洲伟大主教座堂的熟练石匠组织。

sentences.en: Originally at least, the reason for the secrecy was to protect trade secrets, to ensure that not any Tom, Dick or Harry could learn the latest techniques of stonemasonry.
sentences.zh: 至少在最初，保密的目的是为了保护商业机密，确保不是随便什么阿猫阿狗都能学会最新的石匠技术。

sentences.en: But starting from this relatively specific function back in the 14th century, the Freemasons has evolved into a sprawling organisation that spans countries and continents, with an estimated 6 million members worldwide.
sentences.zh: 但从14世纪这种相对特定的功能开始，共济会已经演变成一个横跨国家和大陆的庞大组织，在全球拥有约600万名成员。

sentences.en: It is, on one level, highly visible. There are buildings, called Masonic lodges, that you can see in many towns and cities, as they are typically marked by the iconic square and compass symbol.
sentences.zh: 从某个层面来看，它是高度可见的。你在许多城镇都能看到被称为共济会会所的建筑，因为它们通常带有标志性的方矩和圆规符号。

sentences.en: You can apply to become a Freemason, Freemasons give interviews about what being a Freemason entails, and in many respects, it isn’t a secret society at all.
sentences.zh: 你可以申请成为共济会成员，共济会成员也会接受采访说明共济会成员的职责，在很多方面，它根本算不上什么秘密社团。

sentences.en: For most members, Freemasonry appears to be more about camaraderie, self-improvement, and charitable work than anything else.
sentences.zh: 对大多数成员来说，共济会似乎更多是关于同袍情谊、自我提升和慈善工作，而不是别的什么。

sentences.en: But some elements are still kept secret.
sentences.zh: 但某些元素仍然被严格保密。

sentences.en: There are different levels to Freemasonry, with members needing to learn different codes to progress to the next.
sentences.zh: 共济会有不同的层级，成员需要学习不同的密码才能晋升到下一层级。

sentences.en: And, of course, there are symbolic rituals, oaths, and, famously, secret handshakes.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有象征性的仪式、誓言，以及著名的秘密握手方式。

sentences.en: Again, this mixture of secrecy and transparency has made it a prime target for conspiracy theories.
sentences.zh: 同样，这种神秘与透明并存的特质使其成为了阴谋论的主要目标。

sentences.en: Some believe they secretly control governments, financial systems, or even the media, with claims of a hidden agenda for world domination—what’s often called the “New World Order.”
sentences.zh: 有些人认为他们暗中控制着政府、金融系统甚至媒体，并声称他们有一个隐藏的世界统治计划——也就是常说的“新世界秩序”。

sentences.en: If you spend too much time down internet rabbit holes, you’ll find accusations of the Freemasons’ involvement in historical events like the drafting of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果你花太多时间泡在互联网的阴暗角落里，你会发现对共济会参与历史事件的种种指控，比如起草美国宪法。

sentences.en: Constitution, the French Revolution, and even the moon landing.
sentences.zh: 宪法、法国大革命，甚至是登月。

sentences.en: And, much like any conspiracy theory, any denials of involvement, or even evidence proving a lack of involvement, is not enough.
sentences.zh: 而且，就像任何阴谋论一样，任何关于没有参与的否认，甚至是证明没有参与的证据都是不够的。

sentences.en: It is merely proof that the secret society is good at covering its tracks, or that the person claiming that "nothing of major consequence happens at a Freemasons’ Lodge” just wasn’t high enough in the order.
sentences.zh: 这仅仅证明了该秘密社团很擅长掩人耳目，或者说那个声称“共济会会所里不会发生什么重大事件”的人在组织里的级别还不够高。

sentences.en: Of course, Skull & Bones would say that its members do not help each other, of course nobody would admit to going to a secret meeting of a group of Knights Templar, of course the Freemasons want you to think that they are just a group of friendly old men concerned more with raising money for charity or drinking tea than being global puppetmasters.
sentences.zh: 当然，骷髅会会说其成员互不相助，当然没有人会承认自己去过圣殿骑士团成员的秘密集会，当然共济会也希望你认为他们只是一群友善的老头，关心的只是为慈善筹款或喝喝茶，而不是当什么全球木偶操纵者。

sentences.en: Whether these groups are as powerful as some people believe or simply ordinary people in extraordinary circumstances, One thing is certain: nothing these groups say or do will ever fully extinguish the belief in their secrets; for some, the mystery is simply too enticing to let go.
sentences.zh: 无论这些组织是否如某些人想象的那样强大，还是只是不寻常环境下的普通人，有一点是确定的：这些组织所说或所做的一切，永远无法彻底扑灭人们对其秘密的信念；对某些人来说，这种神秘感实在是太诱人了，让人欲罢不能。

sentences.en: OK then, that is it for today's episode on The Mysterious World of Secret Societies, part one of a three-part mini-series on the loose theme of “mystery”.
sentences.zh: 好了，今天的节目就到这里，本期节目是关于“神秘世界秘密社团”的，这是一个关于“神秘”主题的三集迷你系列的第二部分……不对，第一部分。

sentences.en: Next up, in part two, we will be looking at the unusual history of espionage, and spying throughout history.
sentences.zh: 接下来，在第二部分中，我们将探讨历史上间谍活动的奇特历史。

sentences.en: And in part three we will discuss some mysterious lost civilisations.
sentences.zh: 在第三部分中，我们将讨论一些神秘的失落文明。

sentences.en: You've been listening to English Learning for Curious Minds, by Leonardo English.
sentences.zh: 您收听的是由Leonardo English制作的《English Learning for Curious Minds》。

sentences.en: I'm Alastair Budge, you stay safe, and I'll catch you in the next episode.
sentences.zh: 我是Alastair Budge，请注意安全，我们下期节目再见。
